speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I understand you've been feeling very tired, running fevers, and experiencing severe leg pain and bruising for the past three weeks. Can you tell me if the pain is constant or only when you move, and have you noticed any swelling in your joints?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: I will examine her for any enlarged lymph nodes, hepatomegaly, or splenomegaly, and look for petechiae or pallor. Have you noticed any bone tenderness when I press on her legs?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor
text: I am palpating her abdomen and checking for lymphadenopathy to assess for organomegaly, which is a critical sign in this presentation. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count with Peripheral Smear

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood work shows significant abnormalities with high white blood cells and low platelets, along with enlarged organs. I need to confirm the presence of immature cells to determine the specific type of leukemia. REQUEST TEST: Bone Marrow Aspirate and Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Predominantly immature cells that are positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT.

speaker: Doctor
text: The bone marrow biopsy confirms B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia given the presence of TdT, CD10, and CD19 positive blasts. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
